# `⍟` — Natural log / Logarithm

Function. Keys: `Alt-o 8`. Hanzi: `对` (`對`). Ranks: `0` monadic, `0 0` dyadic

`⍟Y`: ln Y. Pervasive.

```bpl
⍟1                ⍝ 0
```

`X⍟Y`: log<sub>X</sub> Y. Pervasive.

```bpl
2⍟8               ⍝ 3
10⍟100            ⍝ 2
1⍟1               ⍝ 0
```

Uses complex logarithms where needed. `⍟0` is `¯∞`. `1⍟1` gives zero when its floating calculation has a [Mathish type](../terms.qmd#term-mathish-types) and [Mathish mode](../numbers.qmd#mathish-mode) is enabled. Other base-1 cases give an infinity or NaN.

## Inverse

`⍟⁻¹` is `*`. With the right argument fixed, `(⍟↢X)⁻¹Y` is `X*÷Y`.

```bpl
2⍟⁻¹3      ⍝ 8
(⍟↢8)⁻¹3   ⍝ 2
```

## Fast combinations

BPL computes this combination by an algorithm of its own, in any spelling. [Trains](../evaluation.qmd#trains) says which spellings BPL recognises.

| Combination | Applies to | Benefit |
|---|---|---|
| `⍟1+Y`, `⍟Y+1` or `⍟∘(1+)` | real `Y` | log1p keeps the digits of a small `Y` that `1+Y` rounds away |

At an item below ¯1 under dynamic kinds, and on complex numbers, `⍟1+Y` computes `⍟` of `1+Y`. Softplus, `⍟1+*Y`, stays accurate for a very negative `Y`:

```bpl
⍟1+1E¯17          ⍝ 1ₑ¯17
⍟1+*¯40           ⍝ 4.248354255ₑ¯18
```
